person.name: Latin Clark
person.notes: [Created by split package 2026-11-17.] Son and heir of Whittington Clark of Indian River Hundred; his share ($5.80) in the 22 Aug 1837 distribution was receipted by the widow Lydia Clark, consistent with a minor. Name as written in the account.

relationships.evidence_text: Distribution account, 22 Aug 1837: Latin Clark received a child's share, receipted by the widow
